responsibility: Implements discovery and dependence analysis for loop data references in GIMPLE. It builds DATA_REFERENCE objects for memory accesses, derives access functions and innermost-loop behavior, computes alias and dependence relations between references using CHRECs and affine reasoning, classifies subscripts with ZIV/SIV/MIV-style tests, emits runtime-alias-check inputs when compile-time dependence is uncertain, and provides dump/debug and cleanup support for clients such as vectorization, loop distribution, and parallelization.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of the data-reference and dependence-analysis machinery declared in tree-data-ref.h, including discovery of references, dependence testing/classification, runtime-alias-check preparation, dumps, and cleanup.
